Know the warning signs

Don't Let a Small Sign Become a Septic Tragedy

Spotting these common symptoms early can help you know when it's time to call a septic and sewer professional.

Slow Drains?

Sinks, tubs, or showers draining slowly may point to a blockage or septic system issue.

Get drain help →

Gurgling Toilets?

Gurgling sounds or bubbling after flushing can signal trapped air or a drain line problem.

Talk to a specialist →

Sewage Odors?

Unusual sewage smells indoors or outdoors should be checked rather than ignored.

Get it checked →

Water in the Yard?

Unusually wet or soggy ground near the septic area can be a warning sign of a system problem.

Schedule an assessment →

Protect your plumbing

Know The Do’s & Don’ts

A few everyday habits can help reduce clogs, protect your septic system, and prevent an avoidable backup.

✓
SEPTIC-SMART HABITS

DO FLUSH

  • ✓ Toilet paper — normal amounts
  • ✓ Human waste
  • ✓ Products specifically labeled septic-safe, used as directed
Regular pumping = happy home.
×
KEEP THESE OUT

DO NOT FLUSH

  • × Wipes — even “flushable” wipes
  • × Paper towels
  • × Feminine hygiene products
  • × Grease, oil, or fats
  • × Dreams & wishful thinking
Wipes clog pipes. They belong in the trash.
Slow drains? Gurgling toilets? Sewage odors? Water in the yard?These can be warning signs of a septic or sewer problem. Don’t ignore them.

Good to know

Common Questions, Clear Answers

Not sure what your system needs? Here are a few helpful starting points. For advice specific to your property, give us a call.

Ask a Question ↗
How often should a septic tank be pumped?

It depends on tank size, household size, water use, and the amount of solids entering the system. A professional inspection can help determine an appropriate schedule for your property.

What are signs of a septic or sewer problem?

Common warning signs include slow drains, gurgling pipes, persistent sewage odors, wet areas near the drain field, or wastewater backing up into the home. If sewage is backing up, limit water use and contact a qualified service provider promptly.

Do you provide septic inspections?

Yes. Complete Septic Service lists septic system inspections among its services. Call to discuss your property's needs and what the inspection includes.

Can you help with residential and commercial drains?

The business lists both residential and commercial drain cleaning. Contact the team to describe the issue and confirm the right service.

Do you offer emergency service?

The business's existing website advertises 24-hour emergency service. Call (605) 270-9915 to confirm current availability and response timing.
